steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Simultaneous equations: Two or more equations with the same variables. Find values that satisfy ALL equations. | Methods: Elimination: Add or subtract equations to remove one variable Substitution: Express one variable in terms of another Graphically: Find where lines/curves intersect

steps.title: Lesson 3: Application
steps.body: Solve: x + y = 10 and x - y = 4 | Solve: 2x + 3y = 12 and 2x + y = 8 | Solve: 3x - 2y = 7 and x + 2y = 9

steps.title: Lesson 4: Exam Practice
steps.body: Extended Answer 6 marks: A cinema sells adult tickets for £10 and child tickets for £6. On Saturday, 250 tickets were sold and the total revenue was £1980. (a) Write two simultaneous equations. (b) Solve to find how many adults and children attended. (c) On Sunday, adult prices increase to £12 and 200 tickets sell for £1920.
